overview.emptyMaterial: No materials yet. Add them in Master data.
overview.emptyProduct: No products yet. Add them in Master data.
overview.noResult: No item matches. Clear the search or the filters.
overview.reservedHint: Reserved = promised to open documents: materials of scheduled work orders, products on draft delivery notes. Available = on hand - reserved.

item.loadError: The stock of this item could not be loaded.
item.usedInHint: Products whose bill of materials uses this material, with the quantity for one unit.
item.noStockYet: This item has no stock and no movement yet. Set its opening quantity to start.

movements.search: Search by item or document number
movements.noResult: No movement matches. Clear the search or the filters.

adjustments.empty: No adjustments yet. Create one when a count does not match the stock.
adjustments.noResult: No adjustment matches. Clear the search or the filters.

fields.changedWarning: The stock changed after the request: it was {{before}} and is now {{now}}. The result is exactly the counted quantity.
fields.differenceHint: This is what will be booked when a Manager approves.
fields.openingHint: The first quantity of this item in this warehouse. After the approval it is booked as an Opening Balance.

validation.wholeQty: Enter a whole number, 0 or more.
validation.noteRequired: Write a note when the reason is Other.
validation.openingNotAllowed: An opening quantity is only for an item with no movement in this warehouse.

request.title: Ask a Manager to approve this adjustment?
request.description: The adjustment cannot be edited while it waits. A Manager who did not write it approves or rejects it.

approve.title: Approve this adjustment?
approve.description: The stock changes now: the counted quantity becomes the quantity on hand and a movement is written.
approve.done: Adjustment approved, the stock is updated

reject.title: Reject this adjustment?
reject.description: The stock does not change. Tell the author why.

back-to-draft.title: Take it back to draft?
back-to-draft.description: You can edit it again and ask for approval later.

cancel.title: Cancel this adjustment?
cancel.description: It will be kept in the list as cancelled. The stock does not change.

errors.INVALID_STATUS: This is not possible in the current status.
errors.HAS_MOVEMENTS: This item already has movements in that warehouse.

issued.title: Materials issued
issued.hint: These materials left the raw material warehouse when the work order started. They come back if it is reverted or cancelled.
